title: Good Wintertime Meals Are Warm, Healthy and Tasty
speaker: VOA Learning English

sentences.en: Diet and food experts say winter is a time to experiment.
sentences.zh: 饮食和食物专家说冬天是实验的时候

sentences.en: They suggest trying some of the season’s vegetables to cook a healthy meal that tastes good.
sentences.zh: 他们建议尝试一些季节的蔬菜来煮一顿美味的健康餐。

sentences.en: “ Embrace the cold, embrace the winter and appreciate the bounty ,” said Kristen Rasmussen.
sentences.zh: Kristen Rasmussen说,“拥抱寒冷,拥抱冬天,欣赏赏金”。

sentences.en: Rasmussen is a dietician and cook who teaches at the University of California Berkeley.
sentences.zh: 拉斯穆森是一位饮食学家兼厨师 在加州伯克利大学教书

sentences.en: Here are some suggestions from nutrition experts on how to “winterize” your meals: Fresh fruits and vegetables Any produce is good.
sentences.zh: 营养专家建议如何“交互”饮食:新鲜水果和蔬菜。

sentences.en: Only one in 10 Americans eat the recommended amounts of fruits and vegetables each day, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 每10个美国人中 只有1个每天吃建议的水果和蔬菜,美国。

sentences.en: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention says.
sentences.zh: 疾病控制与预防中心指出:

sentences.en: Staple fruits and vegetables are available all year in American food stores.
sentences.zh: 美国食品店全年都有装饰水果和蔬菜。

sentences.en: But winter is also “high season” for a few special kinds.
sentences.zh: 但对于少数特殊种类的人来说,冬季也是“高季节”。

sentences.en: Citrus fruits, including lemons, limes and oranges, are among the fresh fruit available in U.S. stores in the winter.
sentences.zh: 柑橘水果,包括柠檬、石灰和橘子,是冬季美国商店中新鲜水果之一。

sentences.en: Other produce we connect with the cold weather are pumpkins and root vegetables like sweet potatoes, parsnips, beets and radishes.
sentences.zh: 我们与寒冷天气相连的其他产品是南瓜和根蔬菜,如甜土豆、松饼、甜菜和萝卜。

sentences.en: And do not overlook winter’s leafy greens.
sentences.zh: 并且不要忽视冬天的绿叶。

sentences.en: Rasmussen suggests including more chicory into your winter diet, like radicchio, escarole and endive.
sentences.zh: 拉斯穆森建议 将更多的菊花 加入到你的冬季饮食中, 比如 萝卜、食道和耐性。

sentences.en: You can also try different kales and the leafy tops of root vegetables, like radish greens.
sentences.zh: 也可以尝试不同的甘蓝 和根蔬菜的叶子顶部, 比如萝卜绿色。

sentences.en: If fresh choices are limited, experts say canned and frozen fruits and vegetables still have a lot of nutritional value.
sentences.zh: 如果新的选择有限,专家说罐头和冷冻水果和蔬菜仍有许多营养价值。

sentences.en: Just do not overcook them. Also make sure these foods do not have a lot of added salt or fat.
sentences.zh: 只是不要过份煮熟它们。 还要确保这些食物没有太多加盐或脂肪。

sentences.en: Dried fruits, including apricots, dates and raisins, are good for winter meals.
sentences.zh: 干果,包括杏仁、椰枣和葡萄干,对冬季的饭菜有好处。

sentences.en: Nuts can also be tasty, nutritious and filling.
sentences.zh: 坚果也可以是美味的、有营养的和填充的。

sentences.en: “Without a doubt, there's a lot of nutritional benefit , even in dried (fruits),” said Linda Van Horn, a clinical nutrition epidemiologist at Northwestern University in Illinois.
sentences.zh: Linda Van Horn是伊利诺伊西北大学的临床营养流行病学家。

sentences.en: Liquid meals: stew, soup or porridge Soups, stews and porridges are foods that have a long history and are eaten in many cultures.
sentences.zh: 液体膳食:炖肉、汤或粥汤、汤和粥是具有悠久历史并在许多文化中被食用的食物。

sentences.en: They often are made using just one cooking pot which can ease the whole process.
sentences.zh: 他们往往只用一个烹饪锅来制造,可以缓解整个过程。

sentences.en: They all can be frozen easily for a later meal.
sentences.zh: 他们都可以轻易冻起来 晚点再吃

sentences.en: And you can put just about anything in them.
sentences.zh: 你可以把任何东西放进去

sentences.en: “The benefit of it is that it's all contained,” Van Horn said.
sentences.zh: Van Horn说,“好处在于一切都被控制住了”。

sentences.en: She noted that nutrients from the ingredients stay in the cooking liquid, or broth.
sentences.zh: 她注意到,成分中的营养素留在烹饪液或汤中。

sentences.en: These meals are also a way to try out different beans and legumes, which Rasmussen called a “nutritional powerhouse.” They are less costly than produce and provide an excellent source of protein and fiber said Alicia Henson.
sentences.zh: 这些食物也是尝试不同的豆类和豆类的一种方法,拉斯穆森称之为“营养动力库 ” 。 艾丽西娅·亨森说,它们比生产成本低,提供了极好的蛋白质和纤维来源。

sentences.en: Henson is a dietician for children at the University of California San Francisco's Benioff Children’s Hospital.
sentences.zh: Henson是加利福尼亚大学旧金山Benioff儿童医院的儿童营养师。

sentences.en: Porridges — in the morning or beyond — are a good way to try out different grains.
sentences.zh: 早餐——在早晨或以后——是试验不同谷物的好办法。

sentences.en: “You can make it savory or sweet, you can put leftovers on top…,” Rasmussen said, “…or an egg.” Cook for others to nourish mind and body Winter can be isolating for some people.
sentences.zh: 拉斯穆森说, “ 你可以让它变得美味或甜美,你可以把剩菜放在上面... ” 。 拉斯穆森说, “. 或者一个鸡蛋。 ”为其他人做饭以养活人们的心灵和身体,温特可以孤立一些人。

sentences.en: So, join friends and family for meals even when it is not a holiday.
sentences.zh: 所以,加入朋友和家人 吃饭,即使它不是假日。

sentences.en: Eating foods that are “in season” can help people connect with the sources of their food and with their environment, experts say.
sentences.zh: 专家说,食用“季节”食物可以帮助人们与食物来源和环境相连。

sentences.en: I’m Caty Weaver. Devi Shastri reported this story for the Associated Press.
sentences.zh: 我是Caty Weaver。Devi Shastri为美联社报导了这个故事。

sentences.en: Caty Weaver adapted it for VOA Learning English.
sentences.zh: Caty Weaver为VOA学习英语改编了它。
